controls: Eight crosswalk/contact controls: split/merged identities, no-contact originals, point-only vs area, tiny shapes, unmeasured originals, dateline copies, source-binding omissions and exact contact recording.

Eleven whole-file custody controls: unchanged complete bytes, omissions, duplication/redirection, failed generation preservation, distinct actual vintages, immutable execution metadata and exact full executed-code roster.
limits: Analytic controls support the method; mandatory complete-world artifact and semantic omission controls run separately in CI.
